info.flavor: The first mechs fielded in the Makaptan labor conflict were repurposed excavators previously used to create space for tunnel boring machines. Today's Tunneler-class frames are the culmination of that technology, boasting full maneuverability underground and independent tunnel-boring capability. However, they come with steep maintenance costs and the tendency to max out cooling systems.
info.tactics: Tunnelers dive into the earth to bypass obstacles, then strike from below with increased accuracy. They excel at punching through defensive lines and can leave behind tunnels to allow their allies easy access to objectives. Although tough, Tunnelers are slow aboveground, and they are susceptible to control effects and having their tunnels turned against them.
info.terse: Melee striker that attacks from underground and can leave tunnels for allies to use.

name: Lithodynamic Movement Suite
effect:
If the Tunneler is on solid ground, it may take 2 Heat to go underground as a quick action, gaining +2 Speed and the ability to ignore all terrain, obstructions, and engagement. While the Tunneler is underground, other characters ignore engagement with it and make ranged and melee attacks against it with +1 Difficulty. Otherwise, the Tunneler interacts with other characters and objects normally.
If underground, the Tunneler resurfaces in the nearest free space before leaving the ground, after resolving any attack, or as a free action. Neither going underground nor resurfacing count as movement.

actions.name: Go Underground
actions.detail: Gain +2 Speed and the ability to ignore all terrain, obstructions, and engagement. While you are underground, other characters ignore engagement with you and make ranged and melee attacks against you with +1 Difficulty.

active_effects.name: Underground
active_effects.detail: You gain +2 Speed and the ability to ignore all terrain, obstructions, and engagement. Other characters ignore engagement with you and make ranged and melee attacks against you with +1 Difficulty.

name: Subterranean Networks
effect: Immediately after the Tunneler goes underground or resurfaces, it may take 1 Heat to create a borehole occupying the area it currently stands on. Boreholes cannot be created overlapping objects or other terrain.

deployables.name: Borehole
deployables.detail:
The borehole is Height 1/2, does not obstruct movement or line of sight, and cannot interact with flying characters.
1/turn, when standing completely inside a borehole, characters may teleport to any other borehole as a free action as long as they can stand completely inside the target borehole. This teleportation cannot be redirected.
When a borehole is destroyed, it collapses and deals {4/5/6} Kinetic to all characters and objects within, as well as to all Tunnelers that are underground.

name: Borehead Ram
effect: If the Tunneler is underground, this weapon gains +1 Accuracy, and after the attack resolves, the Tunneler may create a borehole without taking Heat.

name: Explosive Excavation
effect: 1/round, after the Tunneler goes underground or resurfaces adjacent to a character, they must pass an Agility save or be pushed back 3 spaces and knocked Prone.

active_effects.name: Explosive Excavation
active_effects.condition: You go underground or resurface adjacent to a character.
active_effects.detail: They must pass an Agility save or be pushed back 3 spaces and knocked Prone.

actions.name: Earthrend
actions.detail: Create a borehole where you stand, then go underground and move your Speed in a straight line without provoking reactions.

active_effects.name: Underground
active_effects.detail: You gain +2 Speed and the ability to ignore all terrain, obstructions, and engagement. Other characters ignore engagement with you and make ranged and melee attacks against you with +1 Difficulty.

actions.name: Burrow
actions.trigger: You are targeted by an attack while aboveground.
actions.detail: Before the attack is rolled, you go underground and create a borehole.

active_effects.name: Underground
active_effects.detail: You gain +2 Speed and the ability to ignore all terrain, obstructions, and engagement. Other characters ignore engagement with you and make ranged and melee attacks against you with +1 Difficulty.

actions.name: Underwatch
actions.trigger: A hostile character begins movement adjacent to or moves adjacent to a borehole while you are underground.
actions.detail: You interrupt the movement, teleporting to the borehole and attacking the triggering character with the Borehead Ram.

name: Sinkhole Carver
effect: This weapon can only be used if the Tunneler is underground. It can target spaces occupied by the Tunneler, but cannot target flying characters. If there are multiple targets, the Tunneler does not resurface until all attacks resolve.

on_hit.detail: Target is pulled as close as possible to the Tunneler and must make a Hull save. On a failure, they become Immobilized until they are moved involuntarily or they pass a Hull save as a quick action.

name: Oversize Tunnels [Veteran]
effect: The Tunneler and allied characters count as standing inside a borehole as long as they are adjacent to it and not flying, and when standing inside a borehole, they additionally gain soft cover which may be used to Hide.

active_effects.name: Oversize Tunnels
active_effects.condition: You are standing inside a borehole.
active_effects.detail: You gain soft cover which may be used to Hide.
